turkey.description: Turkey was updated in Phase 1 from Method 8 (Gulf default fallback) to Method 13 (official Diyanet convention in adhan library). Deltas are astronomically deterministic and explained by Diyanet temkin offsets.

france.description: All 3 French cities (Paris, Lyon, Toulouse) currently retain legacy Method 8 (Gulf) in the production dataset. UOIF (Method 7 / 12°/12°) is supported by the engine but NOT applied to production records. In France, UOIF uses 12°/12° while Grand Mosque of Paris uses 18°/18°.

globalStability.description: All 318 non-Turkish cities retain their exact pre-Phase-1 calculation methods, coordinates, and prayer timing outputs.
